title: Peacekeepers: a squad shooter against thousands of infected, built in Kaigen with Fable 5.2 and Opus 5.5
author: Appropriate_Sail3890
selftext:
Building a game called Peacekeepers in Kaigen. You lead a squad of Peacekeepers through a city of towers, markets and avenues, fighting through hordes of infected called Hollows.

* **Assets:** characters, gear, weapons and street props all start as Grok Imagine concepts and go through Tripo (Smart Mesh, PBR textures). A script then rigs the characters to Quaternius' Universal Animation Library, so the generated models move like a hand-made cast. 
   * Last night I kicked off a job and generated 37 street props in one run, including cars, wrecks, barricades, rubble and market stalls, when i woke up my game was completely different (grok bots helped for scheduling things like automations for websites without api)
* **Code:** I build features iteratively with coding agents against Kaigen's skills and wiki, so the loop is a small change, a build, a look at it, and repeat.
   * Been a long time developer but i know when to let vibes take the wheel, I didn't enforce any structure on the code base, just nags to make sure of this or that just in case.

Some things in the build right now:

* A horde system with fidelity bands: fully simulated Hollows up close, lighter ones behind them and a baked crowd at the back. The benchmark floods in a thousand at a time.
   * Used a type of fluid simulation when things get crowded, and there is obstacles with too many zombies pushing together.
* Locational damage. Rounds push the limb they hit, leg shots make Hollows stumble and catch their footing, and killing shots can sever limbs or tear wounds down to the bone.
   * Opus 5.5 unlocked this nice feature, never done it so smoothly before, usually cutting up meshes at runtime is a mess.
* Ragdolls with muscles and soft joint limits, so bodies collapse in stages instead of flying across the room.
   * watch this video if you want good ragdolls (https://youtu.be/yY6vck8SuCY?si=og3YaqQhsskl2Adz)
* A multi-tool with seven ammo types, and a gatling gun.

Happy to go into the mesh generation pipeline, how I keep generated models light enough for a horde, or what still needs hand cleanup.

I do have a link (no mobile yet) starts in the lab room for experiments. [Try Here](https://zombies.ryanfitzpatrick.io)
